exit=0
--stdout--
# PowerShell completion for hydra-cli: hydra-cli completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native -CommandName hydra-cli -ScriptBlock {
    param($wordToComplete, $commandAst, $cursorPosition)
    $words = $commandAst.CommandElements | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }
    $candidates = if ($words.Count -le 1 -or ($words.Count -eq 2 -and $wordToComplete)) {
        'version help status robots claims claim release limits jog-arm jog table robot audit doctor config shell completion login logout scan fleet stop stop-all metrics manifest connections liveness ecosystem-health plan-simulate' -split ' '
    } elseif ($words[1] -eq 'config') {
        'validate apply' -split ' '
    } elseif ($words[1] -eq 'fleet') {
        'doctor' -split ' '
    } elseif ($words[1] -eq 'manifest') {
        'validate' -split ' '
    } else {
        '--server --config --timeout --json --help' -split ' '
    }
    $candidates | Where-Object { $_ -like "$wordToComplete*" } | ForEach-Object {
        [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($_, $_, 'ParameterValue', $_)
    }
}
--stderr--
